## Structs And Enums

- `FWorkerSlotMesh`, `FWorkerAppearance`, `EWorkerSlot`: modular worker appearance.
- `EItemSize`, `EItemEffect`: pickup/inventory behavior.
- `FEquipmentLevels`, `FConsumableStock`, `FCareerStats`: save/economy state.
- `FPlayerRunStats`, `ERunPhase`: shift scoring and run lifecycle.
- `FRepairStage`, `ERepairMinigameType`, `ERepairStageKind`: repair objective configuration.
